changes: Direct adaptation of ten immutable published lot5B tools; original files untouched.
Lot/schema/path/provenance and source evidence identify new PreviewPacking owner and four native modules.
Exact fixed STCK/SMLP forms, cases, core runners, measured populations, arithmetic, threshold and phase diagnostics unchanged.
Functional capture observes actual Preview proposals, immutable checkpoints and selected-only records without injecting state.
Qualification requires zero Preview records/source-event facts in the foreign-owner cost traces, and proves null scene cache changes from the actual negative proposals.
Each graph delta retains exact validation and explicit owner/checkpoint/fragment attribution; no numeric delta allowance.
